sideA.text: Be sure to read both sides of each card as you make your way through the Legacy deck.

sideB.text:
OCTOBER 15, YEAR 70
Degradation of supplies and routes has reached critical level. We are no longer effective. Supply lines to the interior have been abandoned. Cities will fall within a year and, when they do, we will fall.

Next year's stockpile projections are fatalistic. Haven leadership has voted to initiate the protocol we hoped would never come.
sideB.footer: Keep papers like this in the reserve.

mechanics.whenRead: Immediately after 01-01, while drawing through the Legacy deck. Read both sides, keep the archive, and continue drawing.
rules: Read both sides of each Legacy card as you draw through the deck.
Keep this archive paper in the reserve. No board effect.
mechanics.notes: Side B ends with an illegible handwritten signature under the memorandum.
